result.topic_en: Introductory remark (likely by Dedekind/Weber) and Latin notes on the Commentatio: geodesic (shortest-line) equations for a line element in n dimensions, introduction of normal coordinates x = r c, and derivation of the condition sum p_{mu,iota,iota'} x_iota x_iota' = 0, with struck-out attempts using a homogeneous function omega.
result.transcription:
Diese Stelle kann als Commentar dem zu der Abhandlung „Ueber die Hypothesen welche der Geometrie zu Grunde liegen“ {+zusammenhangen[?]+} angesehen werden. Zum besseren Verständniss fügen wir einiges bei, was die zum grössten Theil aus den Untersuchungen von Dedekind entnommen sind.
[Haece tanquam commentarium {+sunt+} [-eam-] spectari potest commentationis „Ueber ...“
ut facilius intelligantur pauca adjicimus, quae maxima ex parte e disquisitionibus
excerpta sunt, quas R. Dedekind summa cura instituit.]
Sit Elementum lineare in spatio n dimensionum:
$ds^2 = \sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ ; [-...-]
tum ad determinandas lineas brevissimas habentur aequationes differentiales:
1. $d \sum_\iota b_{\mu\iota} \frac{ds_\iota}{dr} = \frac{1}{2} dr \sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial b_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial s_\mu} \frac{ds_\iota}{dr} \frac{ds_{\iota'}}{dr}$ ; $\sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} \frac{ds_\iota}{dr}\frac{ds_{\iota'}}{dr} = 1$
si $r = \int \sqrt{\sum_{\iota\iota'} b_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}}$ est ipsa longitudo lineae brevissimae a puncto quodam ex arbitrio sumpto, $s^0_\iota$ ductae
Jam introducamus novas variabiles, ponendo: $c_\iota = \left(\frac{ds_\iota}{dr}\right)_0$ :
$x_1 = r c_1$ , $x_2 = r c_2$ $\dots$ $x_n = r c_n$
ita ut sit:
$\sum_{\iota\iota'} b^0_{\iota\iota'} c_\iota c_{\iota'} = 1$
et $c_1 c_2 \dots c_n$ constantes in linea quacunque brevissima, a puncto 0 ducta. Sit porro
$ds^2 = \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$
unde facile sequitur: $1 = \sum a_{\iota\iota'} c_\iota c_{\iota'} = \sum a^0_{\iota\iota'} c_\iota c_{\iota'}$
Aequationes [-linea-] diff. linearum brevissimarum, ad novas variabiles relata[-e-] hae sunt:
[-$d \sum_\iota$ ...-] $d \sum_\iota a_{\mu\iota} c_\iota = \frac{1}{2} dr \sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial a_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu} c_\iota c_{\iota'}$
unde concluditur, esse: $\sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\mu\iota\iota'} x_\iota x_{\iota'} = 0$
[-2. $\sum_{\iota\iota'} \left( \frac{\partial a_{\iota\mu}}{\partial x_{\iota'}} + \frac{\partial a_{\iota'\mu}}{\partial x_\iota} - \frac{\partial a_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu} \right) x_\iota x_{\iota'} = 0$-] posito brevitatis causa $p_{\mu\iota\iota'} = \frac{\partial a_{\iota\mu}}{\partial x_{\iota'}} + \frac{\partial a_{\iota'\mu}}{\partial x_\iota} - \frac{\partial a_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu}$
[-vel $\sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial a_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu} x_\iota x_{\iota'} = 2 \sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial a_{\iota\mu}}{\partial x_{\iota'}} x_\iota x_{\iota'}$-]
[-Ex hac aequatione sequitur, $2\omega = \sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} q_\iota q_{\iota'}$ $\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} x_\iota x_{\iota'}$ functionem esse homogeneam secundi ordinis ipsarum $x_1 x_2 \dots x_n$. Ponamus:-]
[-$\omega_\mu = \sum_\iota a_{\mu\iota} x_\iota$ $\frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\nu} = a_{\mu\nu} + \sum_\iota \frac{\partial a_{\mu\iota}}{\partial x_\nu} x_\iota$-]
[-unde:-]
[-$\sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial a_{\iota\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu} x_\iota x_{\iota'} = \sum_{\iota'} \left( \frac{\partial \omega_{\iota'}}{\partial x_\mu} - a_{\mu\iota'} \right) x_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\iota}{\partial x_\mu} x_\iota - \omega_\mu$-]
[-$\sum_{\iota\iota'} \frac{\partial a_{\mu\iota}}{\partial x_{\iota'}} x_\iota x_{\iota'} = \sum_{\iota'} \left( \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_{\iota'}} - a_{\mu\iota'} \right) x_{\iota'} = \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\iota} x_\iota - \omega_\mu$-]
[-$\omega_\mu + \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\iota}{\partial x_\mu} x_\iota = 2 \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\iota} x_\iota$-]
[-Hae aequationes differentiales partiales primi ordinis, numero n, sequenti modo complete integrantur.-]
[-$2\omega = \sum_\iota \omega_\iota q_\iota$ $2 \frac{\partial \omega}{\partial q_\mu} = \omega_\mu + \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\iota}{\partial q_\mu} q_\iota$-]
[-Nunc ponatur:-]
[-$2\omega = \sum_\iota \omega_\iota x_\iota$ ; $Du = \sum_\iota \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_\iota} x_\iota$ $\frac{\partial Du}{\partial x_\nu} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_\nu} + D \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_\nu}$-]
[-Tunc fit: ... $\frac{\partial \omega}{\partial x_\mu}$-]
[-$2 \frac{\partial \omega}{\partial x_\mu} = \omega_\mu + \sum_\iota \frac{\partial \omega_\iota}{\partial x_\mu} x_\iota = 2 D \omega_\mu$ ; $\frac{\partial \omega}{\partial x_\mu \partial x_\nu} = \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\nu} + D \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\nu}$-]
[-$= \frac{\partial \omega_\nu}{\partial x_\mu} + D \frac{\partial \omega_\nu}{\partial x_\mu}$ ; $D\left( \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\nu} - \frac{\partial \omega_\nu}{\partial x_\mu} \right) = -\left( \frac{\partial \omega_\mu}{\partial x_\nu} - \frac{\partial \omega_\nu}{\partial x_\mu} \right)$-]

excerpta sunt, quas R. Dedekind summa cura instituit.
items.english: so that they may be more easily understood we add a few things, which are largely excerpted from the investigations that R. Dedekind carried out with great care.

items.quote: et $c_1 c_2 \dots c_n$ constantes in linea quacunque brevissima, a puncto 0 ducta.
items.english: and c_1, c_2, ..., c_n are constant along any shortest line drawn from the point 0.

items.quote: unde concluditur, esse: $\sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\mu\iota\iota'} x_\iota x_{\iota'} = 0$
items.english: whence it is concluded that sum p_{mu iota iota'} x_iota x_iota' = 0.
